window_size.description: Date window size for the users and groups backfill in ISO 8601 format. ex: P30D means 30 days, PT6H means 6 hours.
window_size.title: Window Size

ApiToken.description:
An Okta API token, sent as `Authorization: SSWS <token>`.

Created in the Admin Console under Security > API > Tokens. The token
inherits the admin role of the account that created it and is revoked by
Okta after 30 days without use.
ApiToken.title: ApiToken

domain.description: The Okta org domain the Management API is served from, without a scheme. Examples: dev-123456.okta.com, acme.okta-emea.com, acme.oktapreview.com, or a custom domain such as login.acme.com.
domain.title: Okta Domain

start_date.description: UTC date and time in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. users and groups are backfilled from the objects last updated after this instant, and system_log from the events published at or after it; applications and application_users are always captured in full. If left blank, the start date will be set to 30 days before the present.
start_date.title: Start Date

resourceConfigSchema.description: ResourceConfig is a common resource configuration shape.

interval.description: Interval between updates for this resource
interval.title: Interval

resourceConfigSchema.title: ResourceConfig
